persona: Operations leaders responsible for how work gets done
desk: Work tracking consolidation — five trackers into one
title: Five piles of work, gathered into one
prompt: Overhead flat-lay editorial still life on a pale timber desk by a window: five small loose stacks of blank index cards in different colours — white, butter yellow, pale blue, sage green and blush pink — fanned out around a single plain grey cardboard archive tray, a hand at the edge sliding the last stack into the tray where all the colours sit together in one tidy row, a few silver paper clips, a ceramic cup of black coffee, soft natural light with gentle shadows, minimal and calm
promptSuffix: No text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks. If people appear they are anonymous and not looking at the camera.
